name: microdrama
description: Precision AI live-action video architecture & prompt engineering system — vertical microdrama series, short films, single scenes or trailers. Plans through 7 gated workflows with 3 approvals via microdrama-director subagent, enforces 25 static & semantic invariants (camera delta, lip-sync pacing, cliché filtering, token bijection, multi-location continuity), inspects 7-gate readiness, packages model-adaptive JSON exports, generates an interactive HTML Production Studio (board.html v2.1), and provides ffmpeg-backed post-generation clip dissection.
